title: Topic 1
japanese_text:
A：あの店のコロッケ、好きだよね。そんなにおいしいの？
B：うん。<u>ありふれた</u>味なんだけど、なんかおいしいんだよね。特に、学校帰りに<u>空腹</u>で食べると<u>格別な</u>んだ！
english_translation: A: You really like the croquettes at that store. Are they really that good? B: Yes. They're just ordinary croquettes, but they taste great. On an empty stomach after school, they're exceptional!
